title: Name an enum parameter's values in reticle_tools
description: paramInfo now reports the accepted values of every enum parameter. It reads them off the enum that enforces them, the same way it already reads numeric bounds off the number that enforces them, so the shown values cannot drift from the checked ones.

title: Clear completed-issue inbox notifications including unread
description: Adds a Delete for completed issues action to the inbox. It deletes notifications for completed and canceled issues, including unread ones, after a confirmation dialog.

title: Add inline checkboxes to issue descriptions
description: Adds task-list checkboxes to issue descriptions.

title: Create a page from an uploaded Markdown file
description: Adds an Upload Markdown button to the Docs header. Selecting a .md or .markdown file creates a page whose title is the file name without the extension and whose content is the file text, then opens it in the existing Markdown editor.
